ObserverEntry: Shared compiled guest worker; complete stacks retained; old fixtures unchanged

OpaqueIdentityPolicy.OpaqueFields: All fields from fun_info/1 and raw fun/wire retained; pid/codehash/index/uniq must not be replaced with cross-runtime expected values. Whole raw equality can still fail; relationships are additional evidence, never a replacement.

InvariantsByField.pid: Raw creator PID retained; compare same-runtime pid==self and original/restored pid equality
InvariantsByField.index/new_index/uniq/new_uniq: Raw values retained in fun_info_all; compare original/restored exact equality within each runtime only
InvariantsByField.type/module/name/arity/env: Raw values retained AND deterministic cross-runtime expectation/relationship rows
InvariantsByField.wire/function identity: Raw wire/functions retained under strict equality; repeated construction and restored equality/different local+external function relationships recorded separately
